prompt_specification: Original 16-bit pixel-art modular environment atlas for a three-quarter overhead 2D forge dungeon in Naki Legend. Transparent background, no people, UI, text or floor. Four separate subjects in a strict two-by-two layout, generous transparent gutters, controlled bronze and charcoal palette. Top left: a horizontal black iron safety railing with bronze fittings and basalt end posts. Top right: matching vertical north-south safety railing. Bottom left: a wide shallow ash drainage trench, roughly 4:1 ratio, thin basalt rim and ember grit, no flowing lava. Bottom right: a small decorative route sign with bridge and handwheel pictograms, no letters. Crisp readable isolated game assets, consistent overhead perspective, original designs.
prompt_record_note: Production specification retained for reproducibility; the source PNG is kept unedited. No Python pixel editing was used.
unused: The decorative route sign is not used. Runtime chevrons and map markers are code-native UI.
integration: NakiPrototype.ForgeGuidance.cs crops the original atlas with Sprite.Create; the original alpha is preserved. NakiPrototype.FireWorkshop.cs replaces the placeholder trench. IceCampWall shares the rail visual.
